purpose: Diagnose whether exacta instability comes mainly from direction prediction or from price structure.

policies.MARKET_ONE: one ticket per pair, market-favored orientation
policies.L17_ONE: one ticket per pair, Seven-King vote orientation; market breaks ties
policies.BOTH_DIRECTIONS: two tickets per pair, both exacta orientations
policies.PERFECT_DIRECTION_CEILING: evaluation-only one-ticket upper bound using realized winning direction
